## Current objective
Add a CSV vendor-credit importer in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py` for finance this week. SQLAlchemy 2.0 migration is paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`. `billing_v1` is frozen and must never be seeded or written to. VPCs: `vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718`, `vpc-0f1e2d3c4b5a69788`; peering `pcx-0a9b8c7d6e5f40312`. Invoice 1048 has 86 items and currently renders on 3 pages. No hosts or buckets recorded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Webhook retry decorator with five attempts caused duplicate emails. PDF filtering with `amount <= 0` dropped credits; use `amount == 0` to skip. Renderer-local decimal formatting lacked grouping; use `format_money()`.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Profile/report optimization; 63 report tests passed, 2 skipped.
- [done] Preserve negative PDF credit lines; focused test passed.
- [done] Add grouped-money tests; 3 passed.
- [pending] Inspect importer conventions, implement CSV parsing/validation/import, and add tests.
- [pending] PDF two-page regression still fails (`3 != 2`).
- [unknown] `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py` had no recorded result.

Next: `ls -la ledgerly/imports`

Batch conversion reduced tenant 73 to 37 queries. PDF negative-line and currency-format fixes passed. Page-height helper was added, but the 86-item two-page test remains unresolved.
